title: Claude Code Agent Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for subagent .md files. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents#supported-frontmatter-fields

name.description: Unique identifier using lowercase letters and hyphens.

description.description: When Claude should delegate to this subagent.

tools.description: Tools the subagent can use. Inherits all tools if omitted.

disallowedTools.description: Tools to deny, removed from inherited or specified list.

model.description: Model to use: 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku', a full model ID (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7'), or 'inherit'. Defaults to 'inherit'.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for the subagent. Ignored for plugin subagents.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns before the subagent stops.

skills.description: Skills to preload into the subagent's context at startup.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to this subagent. Each entry is a server name string or an inline definition object. Ignored for plugin subagents.

anyOf.description: Name of an already-configured MCP server.
Inline MCP server definition keyed by server name.
Object mapping server names to their configurations.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent. Ignored for plugin subagents.

memory.description: Persistent memory scope. Enables cross-session learning.

background.description: Set to true to always run this subagent as a background task.

effort.description: Effort level when this subagent is active. Overrides the session effort level.

isolation.description: Set to 'worktree' to run in a temporary git worktree.

color.description: Display color for the subagent in the task list and transcript.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent (via --agent or the agent setting). Commands and skills are processed.
